notes.title: Dungeons of Clay Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
It's October 5th, and that means - Dungeons of Clay demo is now available!

We are just 2 weeks away from the early access launch, meanwhile you can check out the demo and see what the game is all about. Be sure to share your impressions, feedback or anything else you might have to say.

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Review By Deaf Sparrow And A Chance To Win A Free Copy
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy new year![/h1]

Still waiting to get your hands on Kontrakt? or still undecided? If so, maybe a review by Deaf Sparrow will help. Major press won't cover what might be considered too underground. So, how about something too underground for cult?

[i]"As an indie title Kontrakt offers what it needs to: extreme violence with no care what society thinks, a great soundtrack made from acid-laced snorted gunpowder, a twist on mental illness and the core concept that would never pass a censorship board, and extreme challenge for the true hitman in you."[/i]

[url=https://www.deafsparrow.com/2018/12/25/kontrakt-schizophrenic-hitman-adrenaline-slaughter/]Review by Deaf Sparrow (4.3 / 5)[/url]

[b]Take a chance to win a FREE KEY by commenting in the review using Disqus![/b]

notes.title: A Little Backstory...
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33486093/5e6d2a5a8547c140741d501d7cbdd0e4a7c97d07.gif[/img]

Kontrakt was inspired and is focused around schizophrenia. Fun fact – I myself am a victim of schizophrenia. It hit me out of nowhere by the end of my teen years, I spent hours and years researching the disease and absolutely surprisingly managed to cure it and use the experience as an inspiration for everything I create, games obviously, my paintings, etc.

While I prefer not to talk much about the story, all I can say is that it's quite tragic and twisted in ways that I could best portray the disorder. It's all about the surrounding symptoms of schizophrenia, such as delusions, hallucinations and flattened emotions, leaving the player wondering what's right and what's wrong. Each contract has its own story and serves as an example of what hearing voices and orders are about.

Since schizophrenia is mostly a never-ending dialogue within your mind, I wanted to recreate the same feeling while developing Kontrakt, so dialogues are an important part of the game. That's all I can share for now without spoiling too much. If it might be your cup of tea then be sure to add Kontrakt to your wishlist on Steam.

[url=https://indiewatch.net/2018/09/01/kontrakt-a-game-about-schizophrenia-by-a-victim-of-schizophrenia/]Read the full article at Indiewatch[/url]
